Automatic License Plate Reader (ALPR), Flock camera.
When I enter the town of Cumberland, I see the ALPR on the right hand side.
Operated by URI. Their usage policy is found here: https://web.uri.edu/policies/wp-content/uploads/sites/928/LPR-Policy-20210611b-02.101.02-5yr.pdf
Hardwired Camera mounted to utility pole.
